note: max_connections=500 (default 100): osf.io's development server leaks one connection per request that ends in an unhandled error (the Django teardown that closes connections is skipped), and the health probe plus a browser exhausted 100 within minutes in real install run 12. The limit is a dev-environment safety margin, not a fix for the leak. PostgreSQL 18 (ADR-12): the image moved PGDATA to /var/lib/postgresql/18/docker and declares a VOLUME at /var/lib/postgresql; PGDATA is set back to the mount point of postgres_data, and a tmpfs on /var/lib/postgresql keeps Compose from creating an anonymous volume there. --auth-host=md5 stays on purpose: initdb then also sets password_encryption=md5, and CAS's JDBC driver 42.1.4 cannot answer SCRAM. A data directory of another major is moved with `grdm-dev db upgrade`; `up` refuses it (exit 15).
